name: Argo Northrop
original_name: アルゴ・ノースロップ
source:
The main character. A genuine country bumpkin raised in a rundown fishing village who was suddenly thrown into an elite knight school. He struggles with cultural differences but perseveres by making use of his "Cardification" skill.

Likes: Boats, swimming, fishing, fresh fish.
Dislikes: The cold, rain.

[Taken from [url=http://kaiju09.com/knights_college/english/]official character profile[/url].]
